Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly compared the directors’ birthdates by focusing only on month/day (04-04 vs 05-22) and ignored the years. Homi Wadia was born on 1911-05-22 and Andrew Lau on 1960-04-04; 1911 is earlier than 1960. This led to the wrong conclusion that Young And Dangerous: The Prequel’s director was born first, when the correct answer is Hanuman Patal Vijay.
